svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.37k stars in total, about 1.08k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 481, aube 2028, fnox 2245, hk 1250, pitchfork 678, usage 1055, +6 more 629.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
